transformation: Export only spell IDs already present in PRR, and only the Forever data tree.
Fill missing requirements from native library data, observed Forever trainers, then flagged Vanilla references.
Audit requirements above the native yellow threshold against trainers, native recipe items and own-flavor library data.
Correct verified differences and reject conflicting borrowed requirements. Confirmed learn requirements can exceed yellow.
Runtime applies verified base corrections and supplements below explicit PRR/user fixes.
Corroborate imported trainer IDs against Forever observations and explicit recipe-specific documentation.
Exclude unverified Wrath/Cataclysm emulator trainer pairs from runtime locations and retain their audit records.
Use current-build player trainer captures for missing learning requirements and review trainer identity separately.
Review every remaining unknown at the c16642d baseline and retain exact-source conflicts and unresolved teaching routes.
Classify each runtime trainer by player faction using the pinned Forever NPC metadata and documented neutral overrides.

policy: A documented trainer relationship requires an explicit NPC/recipe listing. Retain a reported training cost when available. A profession-wide list alone is insufficient.

A documented rank requires an explicit Forever learning requirement and matching recipe identity. Check its native profession and raw yellow/gray thresholds independently, including documented learning ranks above yellow.
A numeric fallback equal to yellow without a trainer listing remains unverified. Missing observations do not disprove a reference.
Client AcquireMethod 1 or 2 establishes an automatic skill requirement. MinSkillLineRank 1 alone does not.
Historical Forever beta observations retain their product/build in the audit. Current observations take precedence.
Unverified trainer lists from ProfessionDB Sources.lua are Wrath/Cataclysm emulator data and are excluded from runtime learning locations. Retain per-pair rejection records.
Current-build player learningRequirements captured through the trainer API establish learning rank. Trainer identity is checked separately against explicit recipe listings.

questionMarkReview.scope: Every missing effective learning requirement at the baseline, including two records without colored ranges
method: Check exact spell, profession, crafted/teaching item and native skill-line ability before accepting a public requirement.
Current local trainer captures retain priority. There are no additional captured learningRequirements for these 198 targets.
Read explicit Forever trainer listings and recipe requirements. Review learning rank independently from the raw yellow/gray thresholds.
Current client ranges remain unchanged when a documented learning rank exceeds yellow. Some public lists omit thresholds below the learning rank.
Reject stale Quick Facts when an explicit current teacher row supplies the matching complete range. Preserve each conflicting candidate.
Keep unverified class gates, historical schematics, ambiguous same-name recipes and missing teaching data unresolved. Absence in ItemSparse does not prove unavailability.
Coordinates are checked independently. Existing current observations retain priority over community map coordinates.
